tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: Your connected MetaTrader accounts, newest first.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The account with its status, role and freshest figures.

tools.name: disconnect_account
tools.description: Stops the account's terminal and deletes the account with its stored history. An account a copier uses is refused with `account_in_use`: delete the copier or remove the follower first.

tools.name: list_copiers
tools.description: Your copiers with their followers, oldest first.

tools.name: create_copier
tools.description: A copier copies one master account to its followers. It starts without any: add them next. Masters must be hedging accounts (all of MT4, and MT5 hedging accounts). Retrying a failed request can create a second copier; list your copiers first.

tools.name: get_copier
tools.description: The copier with its master, its followers and what the engine reports about each.

tools.name: update_copier
tools.description: Rename, pause or resume a copier. Pausing stops new copies on every follower; copies already open stay and still follow the master's closes and changes. Resuming copies only what the master opens from then on.

tools.name: delete_copier
tools.description: Deletes the copier, its followers and their activity log. The accounts stay connected. With `close_positions=true` every copy is closed first.

tools.name: add_follower
tools.description: Attaches one of your accounts to the copier with its own rules; leave a rule out for its default. Copying starts at once (unless `is_active` is false), with what the master opens from then on. Retrying is safe: a second attempt fails with `already_following`.

tools.name: get_follower
tools.description: The follower's rules and what the engine reports about it.

tools.name: update_follower
tools.description: Change rules, or pause and resume this follower. Changes apply to what's copied from then on.

tools.name: remove_follower
tools.description: Detaches the account from the copier and deletes its activity log. The account stays connected. With `close_positions=true` its copies are closed first.

tools.name: list_copy_events
tools.description: What the copier engine did, or decided not to do, on the copier's followers, newest first. Events are kept for 90 days.
